# VOLUNTEERS: WHERE THE SUBJECTS COME FROM, AND WHERE THEY GO [color=#5E7066]Pinned. Manifests, intake forms, programme names. Copy the wording exactly.[/color]
### #1 intake_clerk (OP) // 83.04.18 I process arrivals at a research site. Most of it is staff: scientists, contractors, replacement guards. A small part of it is a separate form with a blue stripe, for what the form calls [italic]programme participants.[/italic] The programme names I have typed this year:
- [bold]Debt Relief Volunteer Initiative.[/bold] Colonists who owe the Company store more than three years of wages. Debt cleared on completion. - [bold]Sentence Commutation Study.[/bold] Prisoners. The transfer stamp is from a penal colony I will not name, but it is the one at the end of everyone's joke. - [bold]Post-Exposure Observation.[/bold] Colonists flagged by a colony clinic after a quarantine event. Shipped in medical stasis. They do not sign anything. They are asleep.
Every participant form has an arrival box and a departure box. In two years I have filled in four hundred and some arrival boxes. I have filled in nineteen departure boxes, and every one of the nineteen says [italic]returned to general population.[/italic] I have never once seen a participant on a shuttle going out.
### #2 debt_and_dust // 83.04.18 My cousin signed onto the debt relief one. He owed the store for his wife's clinic bills. The recruiter said it was a nutritional study, six months, three meals a day and a bonus. He wrote twice. The second letter said the food was strange but he could not get enough of it. That was a year ago.
### #3 shift_guard_ii // 83.04.19 I walk the participant corridor on nights. They are in rooms, not cells, with a window in the door and a number. The doors have a laminated sheet taped to them with a row of boxes: I, II, III, IV, V. Somebody ticks them off. Most doors are on I or II. A few have III ticked. I have only ever seen one door with IV ticked, and that door has a second lock fitted on the outside.
### #4 intake_clerk (OP) // 83.04.19 Same sheets here. Phase one through five. We have a word for the doors that reach five among the night staff. We say the room was emptied.
### #5 graveyard_cook // 83.04.23 I run the overnight galley. The participant trays come from a separate order and they are not what the staff eat. Red meat, a lot of it, barely cooked, ordered by the kilo and invoiced as research feedstock. I do not know where it comes from. It is not from any supplier on our books. The trays come back clean. Licked clean, some of them. The phase three rooms send back notes asking for more.
### #6 just_a_pig // 83.04.24 I was rude in the tanks thread. I am going to stop being rude now. My sister is on a Post-Exposure Observation form. She went into a colony clinic with a cough after a quarantine on her mining shift and the clinic sent us a letter saying she was transferred for specialist care. Nobody told us what the specialist care was for. If anyone sees her number I will post it to whoever asks.
### #7 duty_cycle (mod) // 83.04.24 Families: please do not post participant numbers publicly. The Company reads this board too, and a number is the one thing that lets them work out which clerk talked. Post the name and last seen at [netlink="missing.deep" link="missing.deep"] instead, and give the number to someone you trust in person.
### #8 intake_clerk (OP) // 83.05.06 Found something. Three of the nineteen returned to general population were returned on the same day as an outgoing cargo manifest for three units of [italic]biological material, live, Class Black, sealed.[/italic] Three participants out, three containers out. Same day, same shuttle, same signature.
I am not saying what it means. I am saying the numbers match.
